label: Luno
terms_note: Public market-data endpoints only; they need no API key. The docs state 'APIs are rate limited to 300 calls per minute' (HTTP 429 beyond). Live 2026-09-27: GET /api/exchange/1/candles answers 401 {"error":"authentication failure, type mismatch","error_code":"ErrUnauthorized"} without a key, as the docs' 'Permissions required: MP_None' implies. An unknown pair on /api/1/ticker answers HTTP 400 {"error":"Market not available","error_code":"ErrMarketUnavailable"}; /api/exchange/1/markets with an unknown pair answers 200 {"markets":[]}.

list_markets.note: GET /api/exchange/1/markets returns every market (market_id such as XBTZAR, base/counter currency, trading_status, min/max volume and price, scales in raw); the server sorts by symbol and pages locally. `query` is not sent: the API only filters by exact pair codes.

get_ticker.note: symbol is a Luno pair code without separator, e.g. XBTZAR, ETHZAR, XBTMYR (see list_markets). Prices are in the counter currency; volume is the rolling 24h base volume. An unknown pair answers HTTP 400 ErrMarketUnavailable.

not_offered.me: No public identity endpoint; every account call 'requires your application to authenticate itself ... using an API key' (HTTP basic auth). Public-data entry only.
not_offered.get_candles: GET /api/exchange/1/candles lists 'Permissions required: MP_None', i.e. it needs an API key (live 2026-09-27: 401 ErrUnauthorized without one); no credentials in this public-data entry.
not_offered.get_balances: GET /api/1/balance requires an API key with 'Perm_R_Balance'; public-data entry only.
not_offered.list_orders: GET /api/1/listorders requires an API key with 'Perm_R_Orders'; public-data entry only.
not_offered.place_order: POST /api/1/postorder and /api/1/marketorder require an API key with 'Perm_W_Orders' and spend money; not mapped in this public-data entry.
not_offered.cancel_order: POST /api/1/stoporder requires an API key with 'Perm_W_Orders'; not mapped in this public-data entry.
